name: Eddy County Culberson Connector (ECCC) Pipeline
monitor_reason: length: no sourced length found; line is a rich-gas gathering connector between Kinetik Delaware North and Delaware South systems, in service 2026; the Q2 2026 release gives no mileage or diameter
researcher_notes: Kinetik Q2 2026 earnings release (Aug 2026) says the ECCC Pipeline was placed into service, a north-to-south link between Eddy and Culberson Counties, with right-of-way work started for a 2027 expansion. A search snippet from a Kinetik release says it is large diameter, high pressure and can flow more than 150 MMcf/d of rich gas. No length or diameter was found. No match to an existing GEM row (nearest names: Delaware Basin Gas Pipeline P2720, El Paso Northern Delaware Basin Expansion P2577, not the same). Gathering function is also a scope question. Re-check when Kinetik or the New Mexico or Texas regulators state a length; the 2027 expansion is a separate watch item.
